freeze_scope: RQ1 Study B development feasibility audit

source_resolution_audit.basis: deterministic first 1000 joined Eaton pairs; dimensions only, before any Study B outcome test

interpretation_rules: Every listed value originates in an inspector/service record; it is never image-level visibility ground truth.
primary_conditional means the field is in principle image-visible at source resolution only when the relevant component is in frame and not destroyed, occluded, or too small.
stress_test_only fields cannot support the primary attestability claim at the observed resolution.
excluded fields must not be used as image-visible targets.
None of the listed construction or exposure attributes is component-damage presence or component-damage dominance.
Missing and Unknown remain distinct and neither is a negative component-damage label.

street.rationale: Broad roof covering can be visible when roof pitch and street geometry expose it; visibility is not guaranteed.

remote.rationale: Broad roof covering is the most plausible overhead attribute, subject to 512x512 resolution, burn state, tree cover, and crop alignment.

street.rationale: Enclosed, unenclosed, or absent eaves can be visible from a suitable facade view.

remote.rationale: Eave enclosure is not reliably resolvable in the 512x512 overhead crop.

street.rationale: Broad siding material is in principle visible when a facade is sufficiently exposed.

remote.rationale: Facade siding is generally outside the overhead line of sight.

street.rationale: Windows may be visible, but single- versus multi-pane detail is not reliably resolvable across the observed street-image sizes and stand-off distances.

remote.rationale: Pane construction is not resolvable in overhead imagery.

fields.inspector_reference_semantics: on-grade deck/porch presence and material category

street.rationale: Presence and broad material can be visible when the attached side faces the camera.

remote.rationale: Plan-form presence may be visible, but material classes are not reliably attested at 512x512.

fields.inspector_reference_semantics: elevated deck/porch presence and material category

street.rationale: Presence and broad material can be visible when the elevated structure is in frame.

remote.rationale: Plan-form presence may be visible, but elevation and material are not reliably attested at 512x512.

street.rationale: The decisive mesh-size detail is below reliable resolution at typical street stand-off.

remote.rationale: Vent mesh detail is not resolvable overhead.

fields.inspector_reference_semantics: attached patio cover/carport presence and combustibility category

street.rationale: Presence can be visible, but the recorded combustibility category is not consistently image-resolvable.

remote.rationale: Plan-form presence can be visible, but attachment and combustibility are not consistently resolvable.

fields.inspector_reference_semantics: attached fence presence and combustibility category

street.rationale: Fence presence may be visible, but attachment and combustibility are not reliably recoverable from every street image.

remote.rationale: Fence traces may be visible, but attachment and combustibility are not reliably recoverable overhead.

restricted_proxy.semantics: fire-origin location recorded only for Affected (1-9%) inspections
restricted_proxy.forbidden_use: must not be relabeled as component-damage dominance or used to claim H-B1/H-B2
